supporting_observations.claim: The domain account temp.rwong was created at 13:47:45 UTC by greta.lund in logon session 0x11be5348.
The account name follows the stated temporary-account naming convention, and greta.lund added it to the Externals group.

Shortly before the account creation, greta.lund launched Remote Desktop to DC-MAP-01 from WS-GLUND-01; the domain controller recorded a successful remote-interactive logon for her. The logon ID matches the account-creation event.

The RDP path is inconsistent with the supplied practice that remote administration is only done from WS-AHASSAN-01. This makes the method used for the otherwise convention-conforming account creation require verification, but does not by itself establish malicious intent.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the account creation and a preceding RDP logon, but do not show the purpose or authorization for that RDP session.
The available records do not include a complete account-group or privilege snapshot for temp.rwong.
The supplied evidence does not include the help-desk request or approval associated with the account.
claims_not_established: Whether temp.rwong was requested and approved for a legitimate business need.
Whether greta.lund was authorized to use RDP to DC-MAP-01 for this account-creation task.
Whether temp.rwong received any privileges beyond the Externals group shown in the available event.
Whether the account was subsequently used or caused harm.
additional_evidence_needed: Check the help-desk ticket or other approval for temp.rwong, including the intended account owner and duration.
Verify temp.rwong's complete group memberships, account flags, and effective privileges after creation.
Review domain-controller audit and session records for the RDP session and account-management actions, and confirm whether the RDP access was authorized.
unrelated_findings: WS-GLUND-01 accessed acrobat.adobe.com, including an API endpoint named /api/files/recent. Adobe cloud services are not listed as approved; investigate separately. These records do not establish that files were uploaded or shared.
T168-00005 through T168-00030 show browsing to Workday and Power BI services; they are not part of the alerted account-creation activity.
